name: US equity stress
summary: S&P 500 up 1.6% on 4 Nov after the midterms; VIX near 16.6, well under the 20 Watch line
state: The S&P 500 rose 1.58% to 7,688.62 on 4 Nov and the Dow gained 3%, after Democrats won both houses of Congress in the 3 Nov midterms (TheStreet). The index is 1.7% below its 52-week high and the VIX closed near 16.6, inside both Normal lines (Yahoo Finance). October payrolls on 6 Nov are the next scheduled test.
for_you: Conditions are calm. People with pensions or savings in US shares are exposed to swings around data releases, but nothing points to a stress regime as of 5 Nov.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
